map.翻台率多少算好？: What turnover rate counts as good?
map.工具按实际翻台率评级：≥4 优秀、≥3 良好、≥2 一般、<2 偏低。快餐与火锅: The tool grades the actual turnover rate: ≥4 excellent, ≥3 good, ≥2 average, <2 low. Reasonable ranges differ greatly between fast food and hot pot, so the more practical approach is to compare against your own store history and read the trend rather than an absolute number.
map.上座率怎么估？: How do I estimate seat occupancy?
map.上座率是实际开台桌次占理论最大桌次的比例，可用历史同时段开台记录估算。没有数据时: Seat occupancy is actual opened table turns divided by the theoretical maximum; it can be estimated from historical opened-table records for the same time slot. Without data, start with 60-70% and back-calibrate from actual revenue.
